item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:30 HKT 29/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, under the influence of the subtropical ridge, the weather will still be very hot over southeastern China. The subtropical ridge is expected to strengthen again early to midweek next week. The weather will be persistently very hot over the region.

Date/Month: 29/06 (Saturday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4, becoming force 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and isolated thunderstorms. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
